run_retrieval_main: run the main CLI entry point to compute loss on prompts using a pre-trained language model
run_prepare_ctrl_input: run CTRL input preprocessing that validates control codes and warns on missing control tokens
run_prepare_xlnet_input: run XLNet input preprocessing that prepends padding text for short prompts
run_prepare_transfoxl_input: run Transformer-XL input preprocessing that prepends padding text for short prompts
run_adjust_length_to_model: run length adjustment to clamp generation length to the model's maximum sequence length
